gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-anek-malayala: Ethnocentric spaces its fast, aggressive letters well apart, with short ascenders sitting over big bowls. Anek Malayalam, a sans-serif body, then reads smoothly down the paragraph, its curve tips stopping just short of touching.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-carrois-gothi: Carrois Gothic SC keeps every curve visibly open and its capitals nearly level with the lowercase. But Ethnocentric is the one for speed and bite, while the body font handles the quiet work of being read.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-chocolate-cla: Fast, aggressive, spaced wide, Ethnocentric hits first. Chocolate Classical Sans follows with a sizable lowercase and broad-nibbed strokes that never curl shut, and that jolt between them is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-comme: Ethnocentric arrives fast and aggressive, with short ascenders over big bowls and letters pushed well apart. Comme follows with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height and curves that never clog.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-geist: Geist holds a quiet, level line with no accents of weight, its openings wide as a sprung paper clip. Give Ethnocentric the large sizes and let Geist stay modest below it.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-gidole: Aggressive and fast, Ethnocentric pushes its letters apart with short ascenders over big bowls. And Gidole takes over with neon-tube consistency in every stroke, so paragraphs glide along without a snag.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-golos-text: Golos Text fills the line with its tall x-height, draws each stroke in one width, and parts its s widely. Ethnocentric supplies the speed, and Golos Text keeps the lines readable beneath it.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-heebo: Fast and aggressive up front, with wide-set letters and big bowls beneath short ascenders. But Ethnocentric is best at speed, while Heebo, a sans-serif body, does its best work with a tall central band of text.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-hind-guntur: Ethnocentric spaces its letters wide apart, fast and aggressive. Hind Guntur steps in with tall stamped-metal lowercase and strokes of constant width, giving that loud heading a steady partner.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-hind-vadodara: Loud, fast and spread wide, Ethnocentric makes an entrance. Hind Vadodara does the opposite job, keeping a uniform thickness and spacious terminal gaps so its rounded glyphs stay easy on the eye.
